reviews.title: Stories are good but app is awful
reviews.text: Too many ads that are all Ai generated and last way too long. There are better free reading apps with less ads. The ads required to read for free are longer than the chapters of the books. And there is no way to convert the free tokens to coins. Additionally, the 20 second readings to unlock chapters don’t work, I used the timer on my phone and got up to 2 min on a page and it still didn’t register that I read the article. Don’t waste your time.

reviews.title: Shielded by the Ruthless Military Boss

Unfeasible situations, things twisted backwards. A waste of time, coins and money. Now only option is to pay BIg bucks to continue story which is so fantasy. It has been ruined don’t waste it.

reviews.title: Do Not Subscribe
reviews.text:
Started reading on this app for a single story. Was offered a 1.99 subscription for the first week. Opted to read the book then unsubscribe. When I went to unsubscribe there was no record of a subscription. Weird ok forgot about it. Only to look at the bank statement and find 6 9.99 charges over the last month and a half. Closed any and all accounts prior to the start of the next cycle still got charged. Talked to their support bot. It made it seem like they were doing something only to tell me to send an email on the 3rd time checking back with them two days later. Sent off an email to some sketchy Chinese email address to see if I can get a person to cancel this. If they don’t do so on their end I will go as far as chargebacks, card cancellation, and or bank account closure to remove this leach.

Story was nice though for the first 300 chapters or so.

reviews.title: Enjoying the app but has some bugs to fix
reviews.text:
Update: BEWARE

Still have glitches.  Says watch 3 ads and I watch and it still does not give me credit.  It even says surprise you received credit and nothing registers.  Entered a reading challenge and shame on me for not finding the small print hidden behind a question mark after the title.  Read for 40 minutes out of 60 and you will receive a credit back for coins you have purchased is what it states.  I read for an hour and 20 minutes until the coins I purchased ran out. Then it did not refund me.  I try to figure more out and find the fine print stating you had to come back after reading for 40 minutes and before the 60 minutes. If you didn’t you forfeit.  I felt this app was different than others but now I am thinking it is no better than the ones I have tried and deleted because they do not really give you transparency and let you truly read for free by watching ads.

I am enjoying reading the books.  Lately though when it wants me to read 3 articles to unlock a chapter my iPhone puts up a security alert saying following the link is not safe.  So, I cannot read the articles and unlock the chapter.  I also agree that the points should be redeemable immediately and not make you wait 24hrs or more.

reviews.title: A Totally Deceptive Scam
reviews.text: The story I started to read was well done, entertaining. That’s the reason for 2 stars. But every 1-2 chapters requires viewing 2 videos to continue, or pay a prescribed amount. At first I watched the videos - same one over and over. The app said I could read 3 articles to get more chapters, but I had difficulty getting the got 3rd article approved. When it finally approved the 3rd article, I received only 1 more chapter to read. Because I enjoyed the read, I finally paid $8.99 for a number of coins so I could finish the book and maybe read another one. But the cost is deceptive. The chapters are extremely short - only 2-3 iPhone pages, and each set of “20 coins” buys only 1 chapter. I was at chapter 42 - and still not even close to the end, when I found out that I either had to watch more videos or pay more.  Totally ridiculous - and a deceptive scan.

reviews.title: Won’t be back
reviews.text:
This app is incredibly frustrating. A book on any other platform costs anywhere between $10-$20 at the most. This freaking app has “chapters” broken up into 3-5 pages and makes you have “coins” for each chapter. The book I’m trying to read has over 600 chapters. You can watch ads that take approximately 5 minutes to access a chapter that takes 3ish minutes to read. So essentially you’re just watching 5 mins of ads for 3 minutes of reading. If you’d like you can purchase coins, and there are various “deals” available for purchase, one I’d considered purchasing is 7.99 for what seems to equate to 20 chapters. Using the math from that “coin” purchase I would have to spend $239 to read one freaking book! TWO HUNDRED AND THIRTY NINE DOLLARS!!!!!!!

For the actual literature, the author (probably AI) just takes you around in circles prolonging the story, repeating similar story lines, my guess is to generate more ad revenue or make people impatient enough to make a purchase. Anyway, I’m curious how the story ends, but once I make it through, IF I make it through, I will absolutely be deleting this app and never downloading it again. It’s a poor use of my time and CERTAINLY not something I will be spending $239 on!

reviews.title: Don’t subscribe!!!! Can’t get out of subscriptions!
reviews.text: It doesn’t matter how good their books are! If you subscribe, they charge money and the next thing you know even though you paid for a subscription they tell you that you need to pay even more money to keep reading!!!! And unlike the ethical places, they don’t let you subscribe through the App Store where you can just cancel your subscription! They do their subscriptions through outside payment methods so it’s hard to stop the subscription! And on the credit card bill they list a bogus phone number so they can’t be reached to stop the subscription, while all efforts to stop a subscription on their site don’t work. Fortunately after several months of fighting with them while being charged but not being able to read, I did figure out how to shut down the subscription, which could have been shut down sooner if I had known how to do it! It shouldn’t take a bunch of research to get out of a subscription. An ethical company would simply stop the subscription when the customer says stop, and an ethical company would let a customer keep reading as long as they are paying, and an ethical company would not list a bogus phone number!!!!!

reviews.title: The truth about this app
reviews.text:
I decided to try it for one book. The idea that you could watch ads instead of just paying coins was a real boon, compared to apps that require you to pay 20x the worth of a book to read. But don’t be fooled. You need to watch increasingly more and more and more ads to read each chapter. And these are very long ads with multiple stages that require you to click something to move to the next stage. And the chapters themselves get shorter and shorter and shorter. Pretty soon you are practically watching a feature length film worth of ads to read 1-2 pages.

This still might have been worth it if the book was not so terribly edited. Characters who had been killed showed up a few chapters later. Scenes were referenced that never happened. Or the references back to events were so different from what had actually occurred that you could only conclude that the writer had meant to go back and rewrite the scene and somehow forgot. And a few times I was pretty sure that chapters had been skipped altogether. Just missing.

I have heard that these apps do not pay the writers very well. Maybe that’s why they’re getting such terrible writers. I am done with this app. Libby is free.

reviews.title: Not worth the price of admission
reviews.text: This app is a rip off. If you are looking for a good reading app, there are better choices that are less expensive and better quality. I started reading one book that turns out, is 300 chapters. And since you are paying by chapter they just get more and more expensive the further along you get. For this particular book, each chapter is only about half a page and it seems like there is a new writer every few chapters that didn’t bother to read the previous chapters so the same things happen over and over again. I finally got fed up and tried to read the last chapter so I know how the story ended and just be done. It said i could get 50% off to unlock the chapter so I bought more coins only for it to then tell me I could only unlock 5 chapters ahead of where I was! Please don’t make my mistake and spend your hard earned money on nothing! It just isn’t worth it. This app is horrible.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time!!
reviews.text:
I paid $5.99 for the weekly fee that gave me some gold and some points. You have to use gold to pay, per chapter. Which would be fine if there were like 50 or less chapters. However, either the author or the company broke each page into a chapter. The book I wanted to read has 300 chapters. 

They try to “help” by letting you watch ads to unlock chapters but some of them are 4 ads for one chapter. Then they put a limit on how many times you can do that per day. You can watch ads on your account (not inside the book). However, those only give you points. I have no idea what to do with these points, I’m guessing there are games somewhere you can use points to play. Every chapter gives me different amounts of coins to “unlock” them. Some were as low as 15, but some were as high as 43. You get very little daily coins with your subscription. So having a book that has 300 chapters and being limited to about 10 chapters per day, I’d be here for a month waiting to read this book. I did notice the last 5 -10 chapters are marked with a “VIP” label. I’m assuming that means they want even more money for those, which isn’t happening! 

Also, I watched ads for every chapter I could unlock, in a row so I didn’t have to take breaks between each page to watch ads. When I went back to the chapter I left off from, they gave me every other one WITH MORE ADS!! I’m sure the story will be online soon enough, I’ll just wait to find it there. reviews.title: Moboreader, the first 3 days/edited
reviews.text:
So, I'm three days in to this app and the story I'm reading is so hard to put down! The writing is really captivating, but there are minor grammatical errors here and there. The quality of the story is making up for the minor errors so it's not a dealbreaker unless you're a grammar buff. You can either purchase coins to read so many chapters in a story or watch ads to earn coins. There additional features available that will allow you to earn coins for the story such as games, writing reviews and so on. The model is really interesting but I do wish there was bang for your buck but overall the first story is awesome.*******
Update: Unfortunately the further I read the more evident it became there were issues with the story itself. There seems to be missing gaps in the story or complete contradictions at times in the plot. Seems it could be  a result of an AI generated story or a very green writer. The end of the story was very anticlimactic. I was so disappointed.

reviews.title: Good books but they turn out to be expensive
reviews.text: The stories are interesting however it’s difficult to finish a book when you have to keep buying coins to unlock the chapters. When they work out more expensive than a hardback book I think it’s time to give it up. You can watch ads to unlock chapters but you spend more time watching ads than reading as chapters in the book I was just reading didn’t take long to read and then having to watch 4 ads to carry on was frustrating. It makes for a disjointed reading experience. Give an option to purchase the whole book not individual chapters at a reasonable price!
